interventions.title: Structured Attendance Improvement Plan
interventions.description: Establish a mandatory daily attendance verification protocol with faculty advisor check-ins every Monday.

interventions.title: Mandatory Faculty Counseling
interventions.description: One-on-one counseling with Department Chair and Academic Counselor to evaluate attendance barriers and formulate remediation.

interventions.title: Academic Mentoring Program
interventions.description: Pair student with a senior faculty mentor to conduct bi-weekly study progress diagnostics and concept clarification.

interventions.title: Remedial Subject Tutorials
interventions.description: Enroll student into specialized remedial tutorial cohorts for subjects scoring below passing threshold (<50%).

interventions.title: Assignment Recovery Plan
interventions.description: Provide a structured 14-day schedule for submission of missed coursework and late deliverables with guided office hours.

interventions.title: Academic Probation Monitoring Agreement
interventions.description: Comprehensive academic contract with bi-weekly milestone milestones signed by student, advisor, and department head.
